name: tinyMediaManager
description: tinyMediaManager is a media library manager for organizing and scraping metadata, artwork, and NFO files for movies and TV shows, ready for Kodi, Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Browser access is the desktop UI via noVNC.

notes.text: Access is via VNC on http://<IP>:6080/vnc.html or on port 5900 with a VNC client.

Empty /media/movies and /media/tvshows folders are created as optional bind-mount targets (e.g. pct set <CTID> -mp0 /path/on/host,mp=/media/movies). On unprivileged LXCs, match host ownership to the container UID mapping.

Portable layout: settings/library live under /opt/tinymediamanager (data/, backup/, …). Updates use create_backup/restore_backup around a clean deploy. Built-in auto-update is disabled; use the helper script.
